item.title: CHE-US Recalls Magnetic Robot Toys Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Magnet Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys
item.company: Sold Online At: Amazon.com from April 2025 through August 2026 for between t $9 and $18.
item.brand: Sold Online At: Amazon.com from April 2025 through August 2026 for between t $9 and $18.
item.summary: This recall involves CHE-US magnetic stick figure toys. The robot-shaped toys were sold in sets of five or 10 purple, blue, yellow, red and green stick figures. Each stick figure has four small magnets, one in each hand and foot. “X004N3MGCB” is printed on the back of the product packaging.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: CHE-US Magnetic Robot Toys.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the stick figures immediately, take them away from children and contact CHE-US for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to send a photo of the toys in the trash to CHE-USMagneticRobotToysRecall@outlook.com. Consumers should then dispose of the recalled product.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
